title: CYTOGENETICS OF PLANTS
modules: Chromosome Classification Based On Size And Other
Variation In Chromosome Number: An Overview
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of sets from different species."
Allopolyploids are composed of sets from different species.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the area of the chromosome which is rich in genes that actively participate in the transcription process."
Euchromatin is defined as the area of the chromosome which is rich in genes that actively participate in the transcription process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the second major category of chromosome mutations in which chromosome number is abnormal."
Aneuploidy is the second major category of chromosome mutations in which chromosome number is abnormal.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an extremely helpful marker for chromosome mapping in the pachytene stage of meiotic prophase."
Heterochromatin is an extremely helpful marker for chromosome mapping in the pachytene stage of meiotic prophase.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a science concerned with the structure, number, function, and movement of chromosomes and the variation of the properties as they relate to the transmission, recombination and expression of the genes."

Cytogenetics is a science concerned with the structure, number, function, and movement of chromosomes and the variation of the properties as they relate to the transmission, recombination and expression of the genes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the ones that have two centromeres in their chromosomes."
Dicentric Chromosomes Dicentric chromosomes are the ones that have two centromeres in their chromosomes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the failure of the chromosomes to separate, which produces daughter cells with abnormal numbers of chromosomes."
Nondisjunction is the failure of the chromosomes to separate, which produces daughter cells with abnormal numbers of chromosomes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those that remove two to several thousand genes."
Multigenic deletions are those that remove two to several thousand genes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a chromosomal mutation in which there is a change in position of chromosome segments and the gene sequences they contain."
Introduction A translocation is a chromosomal mutation in which there is a change in position of chromosome segments and the gene sequences they contain.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the folding of an organism's DNA into a compact structure that can fit within the nucleus of a cell."
DNA packaging is the folding of an organism's DNA into a compact structure that can fit within the nucleus of a cell.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a long DNA molecule with part or all of the genetic material of an organism."
A chromosome is a long DNA molecule with part or all of the genetic material of an organism.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a seemingly paradoxical process in which universality and uniqueness are harmoniously combined."
Meiosis is a seemingly paradoxical process in which universality and uniqueness are harmoniously combined.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to all possible aneuploids of a particular type."
Aneuploid series refers to all possible aneuploids of a particular type.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the number of chromosomes in gametes."
The haploid number (n) refers to the number of chromosomes in gametes.
fib: ______ are referred to as polycentric chromosomes.
Chromosomes with multiple centromeres
Chromosomes with multiple centromeres are referred to as polycentric chromosomes.
______ means there are more than two poles for chromosome distribution during meiosis.
Multipolar mitosis
Multipolar mitosis means there are more than two poles for chromosome distribution during meiosis.
______ is the presence of an additional set of chromosomes in the cell for a total of 69 chromosomes rather than the normal 46 chromosomes per cell.
Triploidy
Triploidy is the presence of an additional set of chromosomes in the cell for a total of 69 chromosomes rather than the normal 46 chromosomes per cell.
______ is an allotetraploid with normal fertility because chromosome are in pairs, and there is formation of normal bivalents.
AABB
AABB is an allotetraploid with normal fertility because chromosome are in pairs, and there is formation of normal bivalents.
______ refers to the number of sets of homologous chromosomes in the genome of a cell or an organism.
Ploidy
Ploidy refers to the number of sets of homologous chromosomes in the genome of a cell or an organism.
______ is the formation of a progeny called hybrid from mating between genetically unrelated parents.
Hybridization
Hybridization is the formation of a progeny called hybrid from mating between genetically unrelated parents.
______ means the affected person has three copies of one of the chromosomes instead of two.
Trisomy ('three bodies')
Trisomy
Trisomy ('three bodies') means the affected person has three copies of one of the chromosomes instead of two.
______ is described as heterochromatic if the region is made up of heterochromatin.
region of chromosome
A region of chromosome is described as heterochromatic if the region is made up of heterochromatin.
______ are composed of multiple sets from within one species.
Autopolyploids
Autopolyploids are composed of multiple sets from within one species.
______ is defined as the process of union of two gametes, eggs and sperm.
Fertility in Monoploids Fertilization
Fertility in Monoploids Fertilization is defined as the process of union of two gametes, eggs and sperm.
______ is a pentaploid with odd ploidy number.
AAAAA
AAAAA is a pentaploid with odd ploidy number.
______ is a diagrammatic representation of the gametic chromosome set (n) of a given species.
ideogram
An ideogram is a diagrammatic representation of the gametic chromosome set (n) of a given species.
______ is an organism with a haploid set of chromosomes.
monoploid
Summary A monoploid is an organism with a haploid set of chromosomes.
______ are the highest level of organisation of DNA and proteins.
Chromosomes
Chromosomes are the highest level of organisation of DNA and proteins.
According to the course material, how many types of such mutations are there? (answer in figures)
four

There are four types of such mutations: deletions and duplications (both of which involve a change in the amounts of DNA on a chromosome), inversions (which involve a change in the arrangement of a chromosomal segment), and translocations (which involve a change in the location of a chromosomal segment).
